regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing eligible set (6 of 22) with AI Compute & Optics leading on momentum but with only mixed trend health (hurst 'mixed', breadth 0.35) and no crowding. Crucially, gate_helps is false for this market — the absolute-trend discipline did not reduce drawdown on China A-shares history, so the one validated edge does not apply here; the prior hit rate (0.556) is weak and directional accuracy is poor (0.361), so conviction must be low.
emerging_watch: Gold Miners: rank 2 and challenger to the leader, but ineligible (score 0.812) with zero breadth (0.0) and an unscorable proxy (no ETF). Watching for Gold Miners to become eligible AND show breadth above 0.25 — that combination would retire this watch and suggest a durable defensive rotation forming.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semis rank third but are eligible with the best trend-health profile among the AI complex: hurst_tag 'trend' (vs 'mixed' for AI Compute), durability_bar 0.58 (highest in the top group), breadth 0.364 comparable to the leader, and crowding_z near zero (not extended). Unlike the headline AI Compute theme, semis have a clean trending signal without attention risk. This is a relative-durability lean, not a momentum-follow.
evidence: hurst_tag: trend (vs mixed for AI Compute)
theses.dissent: Semis have nearly identical score to the leader (0.802 vs 1.47) but lack the headline attention; if the AI narrative rotates strictly on sentiment rather than fundamentals, semis lag the pure-play AI Compute names despite cleaner trend health. Also, the theme is still subject to the same mean-reverting China tape that made gate_helps false.

falsifier.text: 512760.SS underperforms 515000.SS by more than 3% over any 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are eligible and rank fourth, but crowding_z of 1.58 is the highest in the entire ranks list and the 'crowded' flag is true. Under guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution, and with gate_helps false there is no drawdown-control edge to protect a crowded beta exposure. The high breadth (0.722) suggests broad participation but also late-cycle saturation. A crowded theme in a mean-reverting tape is a poor risk-adjusted lean.
evidence: gate_helps: false (no drawdown edge to protect crowded exposure)
theses.dissent: Banks are the classic China 'value' anchor and often outperform during SOE reform or dividend-policy pushes; high breadth could mean genuine rotation into financials, not just crowding. The crowding flag has no validated forward edge and historically fading crowded leaders is the documented failure mode.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS outperforms CSI 300 by more than 4% while crowding_z stays below 1.0 for 15 consecutive days

theses.subject: Solar / Photovoltaics
theses.thesis: Solar has the weakest score in the ranks (-1.448), is ineligible, has the lowest durability_bar (0.15), and a crowding_z of -2.24 indicating severe under-ownership/outflow. In a mean-reverting tape with no gate edge, the most extreme negative outlier tends to continue lagging rather than snap back. This is a relative-weakness lean, not a short.
theses.dissent: Solar is deeply oversold and mean-reverting tapes occasionally produce violent snap-backs in the most hated themes; a policy catalyst (grid investment, export quota relief) could trigger a sharp reversal that overweights would miss.

falsifier.text: 515790.SS outperforms CSI 300 by more than 5% over any 10-day window before the check-by date
